title: Monotonicity of the Rényi channel capacity under non-signaling assisted channel simulation
summary: We give an alternative variational proof that non-signaling correlations shared between the sender and receiver cannot increase the Rényi capacity of a classical channel. This monotonicity follows from the data-processing inequality for channel divergences established by Oufkir, Yao and Berta. Our approach works directly with the information-radius representation of the capacity. The constraints defining non-signaling boxes are linear in the box, while the Rényi capacity depends on the channel nonlinearly.
